therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: mobilization of leukemic cells from bone marrow microenvironment to enhance chemotherapy sensitivity

results.effect_size: Overall response rate 33% (14/42 patients), with 10/23 responses at 1.5 mg/kg dose
results.target_engagement_evidence: Dose-proportional PK observed with Cmax ranging from 380 ng/mL at 0.5 mg/kg to 4020 ng/mL at 2.0 mg/kg
biomarker_changes: Apoptotic effect measured but specific results not provided
subgroup_findings: Best responses seen at 1.5 mg/kg dose (10/23 responses)
No responses at doses below 1.0 mg/kg
results.dose_information: Dose escalation from 0.5 to 2.0 mg/kg subcutaneous daily for 2 days alone, then 5 days combined with Ara-C; expansion at 1.5 mg/kg
